note: Display-only summary of the rules executed by each deployed live paper scanner. The scanner engine is authoritative. Never contains quotes, prices, signals or live state.

sma9.title: SMA9 base
entry: Previous completed 5-minute option-premium close > SMA9 (mean of last 9 completed premium closes).
Current forming candle open > SMA9. Both conditions are required; LTP > SMA9 is informational only and does not gate entry.
Paper BUY at the sampled live premium LTP; ATM CE and PE evaluated independently, long only.
exit: Trail first: once the premium high-water mark (HWM) is at least 5 points above entry, stop becomes breakeven and then ratchets to max(stop, HWM - 5 points). One-time lock at +6 points sets stop to at least entry + 2 points.
Trail exit only from a strictly profitable stop (stop > entry); fills at the sampled LTP, reason TRAIL_STOP_EXIT.
Then fixed stop at round(entry x 0.95, 2), reason STOP_LOSS_5PCT.
No candle-close, target, reverse-signal or time-based exit in the live loop; a position can be held across candles and overnight.
scope: 5-second polls aligned to the wall clock; signal candles are 5-minute option-premium bars and the forming candle must be current.
Entry window 09:20-15:15 IST, at most one entry per 5-minute candle per option, maximum 2 open positions (one CE, one PE).
Nearest NIFTY weekly expiry at/after today; no separate expiry-day square-off.

sma9-high.title: SMA9 HIGH
entry: Previous completed 5-minute option-premium close > SMA9 (mean of last 9 completed premium closes).
Current forming candle open > SMA9, and sampled live premium LTP > previous completed candle's high. All three conditions are required; there is no LTP > SMA9 gate.
Paper BUY at the sampled live premium LTP; ATM CE and PE evaluated independently, long only.
exit: Identical to sma9: trail first (activation +5 points, ratchet HWM - 5 points, one-time +6 lock to entry + 2), profitable-only, reason TRAIL_STOP_EXIT at sampled LTP.
Then fixed stop at round(entry x 0.95, 2), reason STOP_LOSS_5PCT.
No candle-close, target or time-based exit in the live loop.
scope: 5-second polls aligned to the wall clock with a 2.4-second offset; 5-minute option-premium signal candles, forming candle must be current.
Entry window 09:20-15:15 IST, at most one entry per 5-minute candle per option, maximum 2 open positions.
Nearest NIFTY weekly expiry at/after today; no separate expiry-day square-off.

sma9-trail.title: SMA9 Trail
entry: Self-contained entry (no dependency on the base sma9 scanner): previous completed 5-minute option-premium close > SMA9 AND current forming candle open > SMA9.
The HIGH/previous-candle-high branch in the engine is diagnostic only and is not used by this scanner.
Paper BUY at the sampled live premium LTP; ATM CE and PE evaluated independently, long only.
exit: Trail first: activation at +5 points, first stop at breakeven, then ratchet to max(stop, HWM - 5 points); one-time +6-point lock sets stop to at least entry + 2 points.
Trail exit only from a strictly profitable stop, filled at the sampled LTP, reason TRAIL_STOP_EXIT.
Then fixed stop at round(entry x 0.95, 2), reason STOP_LOSS_5PCT.
No candle-close, target or time-based exit in the live loop.
scope: 5-second polls with a 1.2-second offset; signals from 5-minute option-premium candles.
Entry window 09:20-15:15 IST, at most one entry per 5-minute candle per option, maximum 2 open positions.
Nearest NIFTY weekly expiry at/after today; no separate expiry-day square-off.

sma9-high-trail.title: SMA9 HIGH Trail
entry: Self-contained entry (no dependency on the base sma9-high scanner): previous completed 5-minute option-premium close > SMA9 AND current forming candle open > SMA9 AND sampled live premium LTP > previous completed candle's high.
Paper BUY at the sampled live premium LTP; ATM CE and PE evaluated independently, long only.
exit: Trail first: activation at +5 points, first stop at breakeven, then ratchet to max(stop, HWM - 5 points); one-time +6-point lock sets stop to at least entry + 2 points.
Trail exit only from a strictly profitable stop, filled at the sampled LTP, reason TRAIL_STOP_EXIT.
Then fixed stop at round(entry x 0.95, 2), reason STOP_LOSS_5PCT.
No candle-close, target or time-based exit in the live loop.
scope: 5-second polls with a 3-second offset; signals from 5-minute option-premium candles.
Entry window 09:20-15:15 IST, at most one entry per 5-minute candle per option, maximum 2 open positions.
Nearest NIFTY weekly expiry at/after today; no separate expiry-day square-off.

sma9-atr.title: SMA9 ATR + daily regime
entry: Previous completed 5-minute option-premium close > SMA9 AND current forming candle open > SMA9; LTP > SMA9 is informational only.

Daily NIFTY spot regime gate from completed 5-minute spot candles, refreshed every 15 minutes: BULLISH (price > VWAP, price > EMA9, EMA9 rising) allows CE only; BEARISH (price < VWAP, price < EMA9, EMA9 falling) allows PE only; NEUTRAL or insufficient data allows no entries.
Paper BUY at the sampled live premium LTP; ATM CE and PE long only, one position per option.
exit: ATR(14) of the bought option's completed 5-minute premium candles; distance = 0.70 x ATR, floored at 5% and capped at 30% of entry (10% fallback when fewer than 15 completed bars).
Initial stop = entry - distance; breach closes at the actual sampled LTP, reason STOP_LOSS_ATR.

Trail activates on any new premium high above entry and ratchets to max(stop, HWM - distance) using the distance frozen at entry; no +5 activation and no breakeven lock. Exit at sampled LTP, reason TRAIL_STOP_EXIT.
No target, candle-close or time-based exit; the regime gate never blocks exits.
scope: 5-second polls; signal candles are 5-minute option-premium bars, the forming candle must be current.
Entry window 09:20-15:15 IST, at most one entry per 5-minute candle per option.
Earlier-session positions are closed on startup at the current LTP with reason STALE_RECOVERY_EXIT.

sma9-slope-atr.title: SMA9 Slope ATR 5-second poll
entry: Previous completed 5-minute option-premium close > SMA9 AND current forming candle open > SMA9 AND SMA9 > previous SMA9 (the 9-candle average ending one completed candle earlier). All three conditions are required.
No daily regime gate and no LTP > SMA9 gate; LTP > SMA9 is informational only.
Paper BUY at the sampled live premium LTP; ATM CE and PE long only, one position per option.
exit: ATR(14) of the bought option's completed 5-minute premium candles; distance = 0.70 x ATR, floored at 5% and capped at 30% of entry (10% fallback with fewer than 15 completed bars).
Initial stop = entry - distance; breach closes at the actual sampled LTP, reason STOP_LOSS_ATR.

Trail activates on any new high above entry, ratchets to max(stop, HWM - distance) with the distance frozen at entry; no +5 activation and no breakeven lock. Exit at sampled LTP, reason TRAIL_STOP_EXIT.
No target, candle-close or time-based exit.
scope: 5-second polls; signal candles are 5-minute option-premium bars, forming candle must be current.
Entry window 09:20-15:15 IST, at most one entry per 5-minute candle per option.
Identity was formerly sma9-1min-atr; the DB, service, API and page were renamed, rules are the ATR model above.

sma9-1min-poll.title: SMA9 1-min identity, 5-second ATR poll
entry: Previous completed 5-minute option-premium close > SMA9 AND current forming candle open > SMA9. No rising-SMA9 filter, no regime gate and no LTP > SMA9 gate.
Paper BUY at the sampled live premium LTP; ATM CE and PE long only, one position per option.
exit: ATR(14) of the bought option's completed 5-minute premium candles; distance = 0.70 x ATR, floored at 5% and capped at 30% of entry (10% fallback with fewer than 15 completed bars).
Initial stop = entry - distance; breach closes at the actual sampled LTP, reason STOP_LOSS_ATR.

Trail activates on any new high above entry and ratchets to max(stop, HWM - distance) with the distance frozen at entry; no +5 activation and no breakeven lock. Exit at sampled LTP, reason TRAIL_STOP_EXIT.
No target, candle-close or time-based exit.
scope: Despite the name, the scanner polls every 5 seconds; the original 1-minute identity, DB, service, API and page are retained.
Signal candles are 5-minute option-premium bars, forming candle must be current.
Entry window 09:20-15:15 IST, at most one entry per 5-minute candle per option.

sma9-5min.title: SMA9 5-minute poll
entry: Rule copy of sma9: previous completed 5-minute option-premium close > SMA9 AND current forming candle open > SMA9; LTP > SMA9 is informational only.
Paper BUY at the sampled live premium LTP; ATM CE and PE long only, one position per option.
exit: Trail first: activation at +5 points, first stop at breakeven, ratchet to max(stop, HWM - 5 points); one-time +6-point lock sets stop to at least entry + 2 points. Profitable-only trail exit at sampled LTP, reason TRAIL_STOP_EXIT.
Then fixed stop at round(entry x 0.95, 2), reason STOP_LOSS_5PCT; this level is the fill price, not the sampled LTP.
No candle-close, target or time-based exit in the live loop.
scope: One poll per 5-minute boundary plus a 10-second publication offset; stops are therefore observed once per completed bar.
Entry window 09:20-15:15 IST, at most one entry per 5-minute candle per option.
Signal candles are 5-minute option-premium bars; forming candle must be current.

sma9-adx.title: SMA9 + ADX(14)
entry: Previous completed option-premium 5-minute close > SMA9 AND Wilder ADX(14) > 20, both computed on the bought option's completed 5-minute candles; the forming bar is always excluded.
No forming-open gate and no LTP > SMA9 gate; the confirmation field is informational only.
Paper BUY at the sampled live premium LTP; ATM CE and PE long only, one position per option.
exit: Initial stop = entry x 0.95 (5% below entry), reason STOP_LOSS_5PCT.
Once the premium is above entry, stop = max(entry x 0.95, HWM x 0.95), ratcheting upward only; no +5 activation, no fixed 5-point trail and no breakeven lock.
No target, candle-close or time-based exit; the 5% trail and 5% stop are the only exits.
scope: 5-second polls; entry window 09:20-15:15 IST, at most one entry per 5-minute candle per option.
ADX needs at least 2 x 14 completed premium bars before an entry is possible; the forming candle must be the current 5-minute bucket.

ADX(14) > 20 is the only filter added to the base SMA9 entry; the 5-second identity, DB and service are otherwise unchanged. A restart can close a position from an already-ended entry candle at that candle's close (SAME_CANDLE_EXIT); normal polling has no time exit.

pattern_scanner.title: Pattern Scanner
entry: Bullish or bearish candlestick pattern detected on a completed NIFTY SPOT 5-minute candle (about 37 named patterns on each side, e.g. Hammer, Bullish Engulfing, Morning Star; full list in the engine).
Bullish signal buys the ATM CE; bearish signal buys the ATM PE. Long only on both sides, never short CE or PE. Pattern body thresholds use Wilder ATR(14) on completed spot candles.

Entry price is the option's LTP sampled at the poll that closes the spot candle; a quote older than 20 seconds is rejected and the entry is skipped. The signal candle must start before 15:15 IST (last eligible start 15:10); at most one position per pattern:instrument.
exit: Premium ATR(14) from completed 5-minute bars of the exact bought option. Distance = 0.70 x ATR, clamped to 5%-30% of entry; 10% fallback with fewer than 15 completed bars.
Initial stop = entry - distance; breach detected from the completed bar's low, reason STOP_LOSS_ATR.
Trail ratchets to max(stop, HWM - distance) on the completed bar high and is checked against that bar's high/low, reason TRAIL_STOP_EXIT. No +5 activation and no breakeven lock.

Exit fill is the lower of the two candidate levels from that completed 5m option bar (conservative OHLC proxy shared with the backtest); sampled spot ticks never manage an exit. No target, candle-close or time-based exit.
scope: One poll per 5-minute boundary plus 10 seconds; this is the only scanner on an aligned 5-minute cadence.
Entry signals come from NIFTY spot candles; all exits come from the position's own option premium candles.
A position entered at a bar-close poll is first managed on the next poll's completed bar.
